notablePrerequisites:
Viridian Longbow attached to Felhide Spiritbinder.
Felhide Spiritbinder does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Felhide Spiritbinder by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Burning-Tree Emissary by paying {R/G}{R/G}.
Burning-Tree Emissary enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Burning-Tree Emissary trigger, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Felhide Spiritbinder triggers, holding priority, activate it by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Felhide Spiritbinder trigger, causing you to pay {1}{R} to create a token copy of Burning-Tree Emissary with haste.
Repeat from step 3.
